rawContent: I'm less excited for Patriots football than usual because I'm uncomfortable with Antonio Brown being on the team. I know innocent until proven guilty...but #MeToo has taught me to believe women and I am just uncomfortable with him. I wish the @NFL had exempted him.

I feel horrible for black people in America. for a while, you had to worry that cops were going to pull you over and kill you at a routine traffic stop. Now they're just coming into your homes and murdering you.

POLICE BRUTALITY AND RACISM MUST BE STOPPED

#BlackLivesMatter
